meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容编排成可翻页的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把想法整理成演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Create a navigable slideshow from your content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to turn ideas into a slide deck

howto.what: Claude会生成一个可导航的HyperFrames幻灯片演示（deck），含多张幻灯片、片段揭示、分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注；也能把现有网页转换成deck。输出是可交互的deck，不是MP4视频。
howto.when: 明确要求做幻灯片/slideshow时直接执行；提到“演示文稿”“deck”等相邻词时，会先询问确认是否要HyperFrames slideshow，确认后才开始制作。

say.text: 帮我把这份产品介绍做成幻灯片演示。
say.note: 会生成可导航的deck并带有演讲者备注。

say.text: 把公司官网转成可导航的deck，保留原有效果。
say.note: 会先确认转换意图再执行。

say.text: 做一套带分支跳转和热点导航的演示文稿。
say.note: 可交互的deck，支持点击热点跳转。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate a navigable HyperFrames slideshow deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter notes; it can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is an interactive deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers directly when the user asks for a slideshow or HyperFrames slideshow; for related terms like 'presentation' or 'deck', it pauses to confirm before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn this product intro into a slideshow.
say_en.note: Produces a navigable deck with speaker notes.

say_en.text: Convert our company website into an interactive deck.
say_en.note: It will confirm the intent first.

say_en.text: Make a slide deck with branching and hotspot navigation.
